name: pg-boss
solves: Provides a Postgres-backed job queue for Node.js using SKIP LOCKED for safe concurrent claiming, with cron/schedules, retries, priorities, and pub/sub — without introducing Redis as infrastructure.
best_for: Node apps that already run PostgreSQL and want a reliable queue without Redis
Transactional outbox-style work where jobs must commit with business data in the same database
Cron and delayed jobs with retries, backoff, and expiration in Postgres
Teams that want operational simplicity — one datastore for app state and jobs
Moderate-throughput backends where Postgres SKIP LOCKED is sufficient
skip_when: You need extreme throughput or Redis-native features (streams, Lua) — use BullMQ
You are serverless-first with no long-lived worker and prefer Inngest/Trigger.dev
You want a fully managed orchestration platform with zero queue ops
Your stack is Python-first (consider other PG queues or Celery)
You need complex parent/child job DAGs — BullMQ flows or Temporal fit better

hosted_alternative.name: Inngest
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier for hobby; paid plans scale with executions and concurrency
